Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_LootSpawnMul: Controls how often Energy Routing and ERS - Small Producers Pack items appear in loot (x0.25, x0.50, x0.75, x1, x2, x3, x5).
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_CableSpawnAm: Controls how many energy transfer cables appear together when a cable spawns in loot.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_DismantleEle: Minimum Electricity XP awarded when picking up or dismantling ERS objects and packs. Some large objects award more XP. Use 0 to disable.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_ConsumerScan: How often the controller performs a periodic full consumer cache refresh. Dirty events still force an immediate refresh.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_ControllerVe: How many floors above and below the controller are included for energy distribution and consumer scans (0 = same floor only).
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_EconomicMode: Makes ERS work like a vanilla generator: the controller only turns whole-building power ON/OFF and skips consumer scans.
Fixed watt requirement consumed by the economic mode while the controller is powering the building. Set 0 to allow any available ERS energy.
Radius around the controller used by economic whole-building power. Default is 20 tiles.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_DebugLogs_to: Enables verbose ERS console logging for debugging. Keep disabled on servers to avoid spam.
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_LootSpawnMultiplie: Controls how often Energy Routing and ERS - Small Producers Pack items appear in loot (x0.25, x0.50, x0.75, x1, x2, x3, x5).
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_CableSpawnAmount_t: Controls how many energy transfer cables appear together when a cable spawns in loot.
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_DismantleElectrici: Minimum Electricity XP awarded when picking up or dismantling ERS objects and packs. Some large objects award more XP. Use 0 to disable.
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_ConsumerScanInterv: How often the controller performs a periodic full consumer cache refresh. Dirty events still force an immediate refresh.
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_ControllerVertical: How many floors above and below the controller are included for energy distribution and consumer scans (0 = same floor only).
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_EconomicMode_toolt: Makes ERS work like a vanilla generator: the controller only turns whole-building power ON/OFF and skips consumer scans.
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_EconomicModeMinimu: Fixed watt requirement consumed by the economic mode while the controller is powering the building. Set 0 to allow any available ERS energy.
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_EconomicModeRadius: Radius around the controller used by economic whole-building power. Default is 20 tiles.
